meta.name: English
meta.note: key 是中文原文，value 是英文译文。缺失的条目自动回退中文。

strings.0 最快、11 最小。9 是体积/速度平衡点；11 在 100MB 上可能要几十: 0 is fastest, 11 is smallest. 9 balances size and speed; 11 can take tens of seconds on 100 MB.
strings.0 表示本次会话内一直保持解锁。: 0 means stay unlocked for the whole session.
strings.Custom 表示沿用界面上的百分比定位；选具体锚点后按「锚点 + 偏移(mm): Custom keeps the percentage position; a concrete anchor uses anchor + offset (mm).
strings.Custom 表示沿用界面上的百分比定位；选具体锚点后改为「锚点 + 边距 +: Custom keeps the percentage position from the main page; a concrete anchor switches to anchor + margin + offset.
strings.ECIES 的密钥派生上下文，改了两边必须一致。: Key derivation context for ECIES; both sides must match if changed.
strings.RTF 忽略型目标组的名字。: Name of a destination group that RTF ignores.
strings.ZIP 规范硬上限 65535，超了只能重打包。: Hard ZIP limit is 65535; beyond that the archive has to be rebuilt.
strings.不提供章也可以验证：能确认记录未被改动，但无法证明它来自谁。: Verifying without a seal is possible: it confirms the record was not altered, but cannot prove who issued it.
strings.也可以用系统自带的画图 / Illustrator 做好 SVG 再导入。: You can also prepare an SVG in Paint or Illustrator and import it.
strings.也可以直接把文件或一批文件拖进这里: You can also drag files or a whole folder here
strings.仅在目标图片为 JPEG 或需要重新编码时使用。: Only used for JPEG targets or when re-encoding is required.
strings.任何一项校验失败都判为失败（关闭时仅警告）。: Any failed check counts as a failure (warning only when disabled).
strings.例如：仅用于 XX 项目内部文件，不代表法律效力: e.g. Internal use for project XX; not legally binding
strings.关闭时每次启动都按默认尺寸（1920×1080）打开；开启则用上次关闭时的位置和: Off: opens at the default 1920×1080 every time. On: reuses the last position and size.
strings.加载时先检查结构（zip/7z/pdf）是否完整，避免把损坏文件改坏。: Checks the container structure (zip/7z/pdf) before loading, so a damaged file is not made worse.
strings.压缩后反而更大时原样保存。: Stores the original when compression makes it larger.
strings.在图片 / PDF 上贴出图案: Stamp the artwork onto images / PDF
strings.多枚章时检查盖章时间是否倒挂。: Checks for out-of-order timestamps when a file carries several seals.
strings.存在章里，换电脑也能用；盖章时可选择是否贴到图片 / PDF 上。: Stored in the seal file and usable on another PC; choose whether to stamp it onto images / PDF.
strings.小于该值直接不压缩，省 CPU。: Files below this size are not compressed, saving CPU.
strings.已有章文件？去盖章页载入: Already have a seal file? Load it on the Seal page
strings.影响进度刷新粒度与内存占用。: Affects progress granularity and memory use.
strings.所有可调参数都在这里；改完点「保存设置」写入程序目录 config\\setti: All tunable options live here. Click "Save settings" to write them to config\settings.json next to the program.
strings.把章写进文件的空白区：只追加、不覆盖已有内容，原文件照常打开。: Writes the seal into a file's unused space: append-only, nothing overwritten, the file still opens normally.
strings.拖动预览里的章可调位置，拖右下角改大小；PDF 页码填 0 表示全部页。预览用当: Drag the seal in the preview to move it, drag its bottom-right corner to resize. A PDF page of 0 means all pages. The preview uses the real page of the selected file, so what you see is what gets stamped.
strings.描述（写进记录，验章时显示）: Description (stored in the record, shown on verification)
strings.操作短于该时间就完全不显示，避免闪烁。: Operations shorter than this are not shown at all, avoiding flicker.
strings.新建章时默认勾选口令保护。: Pre-checks passphrase protection for new seals.
strings.无章时提示局限性: Warn about limits when no seal
strings.曲线越长越安全、签名越大；P-256 已足够: Longer curves are safer but produce larger signatures; P-256 is enough
strings.没有章的文件只能证明「当前内容未被改动」，不能证明来源。: Without a seal, a file only proves its content is unchanged, not who issued it.
strings.生成一个 .bin 章文件：内含 ECC 密钥、章字节、描述与图案。私钥可用口令: Creates a .bin seal file containing the ECC keys, seal bytes, description and artwork. The private key can be protected with a passphrase.
strings.用于二进制 0/1 的两个码点，逗号分隔十六进制。: Two code points used for bits 0 and 1, comma-separated hex.
strings.用口令保护私钥（推荐）: Protect the private key with a passphrase (recommended)
strings.用章内公钥重算指纹，确认章文件未被替换。: Recomputes the fingerprint from the seal's public key to confirm the seal file was not swapped.
strings.盖章前把原文件复制一份 .bak，失败时可回滚。: Copies the original to .bak before sealing so it can be rolled back.
strings.章字节可以是任意内容：一段授权说明、一个序列号，或由程序生成的一份清单。\r\n:
Seal bytes can be anything: a license note, a serial number, or a list generated by the app.
A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered, so keep the .bin and the passphrase separate.
strings.章字节可以是任意内容：一段授权说明、一个序列号，或由程序生成的一份清单。 口令一: Seal bytes can be anything: a license note, a serial number, or a list generated by the app. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered, so keep the .bin and the passphrase separate.
strings.章私钥默认口令保护: Protect seal private key by default
strings.耗时未知的计算显示转圈动画。: Shows a spinner for work of unknown duration.
strings.贴图前备份原文件（.bak）: Back up the original before stamping (.bak)
strings.越高越抗暴力破解，也越慢。默认 40000 在普通机器上约 250ms。: Higher is harder to brute-force but slower. The default 40000 takes about 250 ms on a typical machine.
strings.这一段会作为「章字节」原样加密进记录（UTF-8 编码）: Stored as the seal bytes, encrypted exactly as written (UTF-8)
strings.选择文件后点「开始验证」。: Choose a file, then click Start.
strings.逐项检查盖章记录、章身份与文件内容，并说明结论的适用范围。: Checks the seal record, seal identity and file content item by item, and states how far the conclusion reaches.
strings.避免遮挡正文。: Keeps the artwork from covering body text.
strings.重启后生效。System 跟随 Windows 的应用主题设置。: Takes effect after restart. System follows the Windows app theme setting.
strings.重启后生效。System 跟随 Windows 的显示语言。: Takes effect after restart. System follows the Windows display language.
strings.重编码图片时保留原始 EXIF。: Keeps the original EXIF when re-encoding images.
